entities.name: Pangolin
entities.description: Scaly mammal species whose scales resist all sorts of damage; found on many planes.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane whose forests are inhabited by large scaled pangolin beasts with two tusks.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane home to black-scaled pangolins many times larger than a human.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Plane home to gloom pangolins, which are nightmares.

entities.name: Gannet
entities.description: A skysail zoologist who described the gloom pangolin.

entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: Plane whose forests are inhabited by pangolins that curl and roll.

events.summary: Gannet states the gloom pangolin survives on a purely bioluminescent diet and is active only on the darkest Indatha nights.
events.quote: Gannet , a skysail zoologist, stated that it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet

relations.note: Gloom pangolins are nightmares of Ikoria.
relations.quote: Ikoria is home to gloom pangolins which are nightmares .
